title: XQS Strawberry Kiwi Nicotine Pouches - 8mg/Pouch
description: XQS Strawberry Kiwi tastes light and balanced, combining sweet Strawberry with a gentle Kiwi tang for a clear, fruity profile. Each slim, all‑white pouch sits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. This can contains 20 pouches in 8mg (Medium). Made by Swedish brand XQS, the range favours familiar fruit combinations in a simple, discreet format for everyday use. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
